author: raoatifshad
body:
**PR description**

Scans the unit-test, addOn and RelVal logs of each IB for the IB chatbot, at the moment cms-bot has them unpacked anyway, and writes a small summary file next to the zip.
es_ibs_log.py (ib-build-logs) and jenkins-jobs/process-relval-logs already unpack the unit-test, addOn and RelVal logs of each IB. Right after that, a stdlib-only scanner (ib_test_log_scanner.py, entry point ib_test_log_problems.py, Python 3.8+) writes a small summary next to the zip:

  unitTestLogs-scan.json.gz, addOnTests-scan.json.gz, pyRelValMatrixLogs-scan.json.gz

(.tmp + rename, never inside the zip). A separate sender job sends these files to the chatbot; nothing here talks to the network.

The jobs' own work is unchanged: es_ibs_log.py calls the scanner in try/except (an import failure only prints an error), and the RelVal hook runs after the existing cleanup, before the zip, with `|| true`. DBG RelVals (~220 GB unpacked per run) are skipped for now (TEST_LOG_SCAN_DBG_RELVAL=1 turns them on).

**Output** (one file per zip, in the build folder, never inside the zip):

    unitTestLogs.zip         -> unitTestLogs-scan.json.gz
    addOnTests.zip           -> addOnTests-scan.json.gz
    pyRelValPartialLogs/     -> pyRelValMatrixLogs-scan.json.gz

Every test with its status, the problems found in its logs (exceptions, sanitizer reports, tracebacks, fatal messages, ...) and which build it belongs to. Written as `.tmp` + rename. A separate sender job ((PR #2909) sends these files to the chatbot VM;

**Jobs are not affected if it breaks**
- `es_ibs_log.py`: the import and each call are in `try/except`; a missing or crashing scanner only prints `ERROR: test-log scan ...`.
- `process-relval-logs`: the call ends in `|| true` (the script runs with `bash -e`).
- No new dependencies: standard library only, Python 3.8+. It only reads the unpacked logs and writes one file; it never writes inside the folder that gets zipped.
title: Scan IB test logs for the IB chatbot while they are unpacked
